author: epicbogdn
body: I have been banned by Mod Exellence and he banned me for using x ray. The reason i think that i should get unbanned is because i've been playing walls for 2 years. and the map called "lands" has the diamonds in the places that the old map "village" has. I watched Murph_The_Cat's vedeo's on youtube and learned alot about the map "Village" so when i found out about lands having the same placed diamonds I knew where 26 diamonds were and got them, And the fact that i have a SLOW laptop is probably a reason why I cant use the X-Ray hack. Please let me come back to playing walls. Thx!
